head: DAY 3. CHECKOUT.
4:58 AM.
cover_sub: Third straight morning in the dark.

items.label: Alarm. Third day.
items.cap: Alarm. Third day. My body stopped arguing.

items.label: Car packed in the dark.
items.cap: Car packed in the dark. Gear bag goes in last. Always.

items.label: Windshield scraped.
items.cap: Windshield scraped. With the hotel key card.

items.label: Waffle line, day three.
items.cap: Waffle line, day three. Same waffle. No complaints.

items.label: Kid asleep by the exit.
items.cap: Kid's asleep before we leave the lot. Seat belt on, eyes off.

items.label: Rink coffee.
items.cap: Rink coffee. The lady at the counter knows my order now.

end: Three days. One hotel. One rink. Tomorrow I sleep till six.
